title: Solar Eclipse on August 12
summary: A solar eclipse will occur on August 12, 2026. The eclipse will not be visible in India, but some zodiac signs may be affected. The eclipse is the last one of the year. Some outlets report that individuals belonging to certain zodiac signs need to be cautious. The eclipse will occur during the day, causing darkness.
summary_points: A solar eclipse will occur on August 12, 2026.
The eclipse will not be visible in India.
Some zodiac signs may be affected by the eclipse.
The eclipse is the last one of the year.
It will occur during the day, causing darkness.
